data.one_liner: A customizable video player wrapper for Flutter that provides base architecture for custom UI.
data.what_it_does: Flick Video Player wraps the low-level video_player plugin and provides a manager-based architecture and custom UI components. It supports double-tap to seek, auto-hide controls, fullscreen toggling, playback speed changes, and keyboard shortcuts for web.
use_when: You need a customizable video player with specific UI and control requirements.
You want to build custom video player controls and layouts on top of video_player.
avoid_when: You only need a basic video player and are completely satisfied with the default video_player UI.
You need a dedicated YouTube player iframe implementation.
strengths: Highly customizable UI components and layout architecture.
Supports web keyboard shortcuts and mobile gestures like double-tap to seek.
Built-in managers handling state, control, and display logic.
weaknesses: Relies on video_player under the hood, inheriting its platform limitations.
data.setup_notes: Add flick_video_player and video_player to pubspec.yaml and initialize a FlickManager.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the official, low-level video player implementation without any wrapper architecture.

alternatives.name: youtube_player_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your primary goal is specifically embedding and playing YouTube videos.
